info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Routes-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Routes Retrieval API provides a streamlined way to access information about logistics shipment routes. Users can retrieve detailed data on various routes used for transporting goods, facilitating enhanced decision-making for supply chain management. This API is essential for logistics managers, route planners, and developers who need to integrate shipment route data into their applications. Use cases include optimizing delivery routes, tracking shipment progress, and improving overall logistics efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the optimal route for their shipments based on current logistics data. Utilize this feature to enhance delivery efficiency and reduce shipping times.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the optimal shipping route based on the provided criteria. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema to avoid errors.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the shipment route details.
